name: Planner — pickup & delivery
description: The route planner must sequence each parcel's pickup before its delivery, narrate collections in the briefing, and never leak internal refs / ids / coordinates. Runs with FAKE_ROUTES=1 (no Google) but needs GOOGLE_API_KEY for the agent + the response judge.
